chunks: And Ibn Abī ʿUmayr narrated from al-Kāhilī, who said: Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام said:
A glance after a glance plants desire in the heart, and it is sufficient as a trial for its beholder.

key_terms.اَلنَّظْرَةُ بَعْدَ اَلنَّظْرَةِ: a repeated glance after the first look
key_terms.اَلْقَلْبِ: the heart, as the inner moral and spiritual faculty
key_terms.فِتْنَةً: a trial, temptation, or source of moral testing

ai.seo_question: What does Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام say about repeated glances and desire?
ai.summary: This hadith warns that repeated looking can cultivate shahwah in the heart. It presents the lingering gaze itself as a moral and spiritual fitnah, underscoring the need for restraint in one's sight.
